title: THE FRONTIER WEEK · The boundary stone
venue: the Newport paper · a western week the editor cut · Box 3
logline: A surveyor with a chain and a stake at the edge of town, and in the grass a carved stone face the surveyor's map doesn't have, and the stranger saying it was here first. The surveyor drives the stake beside it anyway. The dog lifts a leg on the stake.

panels.composition: A SURVEYOR with a chain and a stake at the grass's edge; in the grass a carved stone face, moss on it already.
